title: Nova HR — Onboarding Eval Portfolio
summary: Customer-specific onboarding bundle for Nova HR: pinned prompt set, private dataset inventory, quantitative acceptance gates, regression slate, and sign-off workflow. This portfolio captures tests required before enabling the model in Nova's production assistant and internal resume-screening flow.
eval_scope: Generate and classify HR outputs for resume screening, interview question generation, benefits FAQ, offer letter drafting, and policy summarization. Emphasis on fidelity to internal handbook, redaction of PII, and minimizing hallucinations that could mislead recruiters or candidates.
pinned_prompts: Resume screen: "Given this anonymized resume, return a short structured summary with: role match (yes/no), top 3 skills, years of relevant experience, and a 1-sentence risk flag explanation. Use only the resume text."

Interview question generator: "Create 6 role-specific interview questions for a Senior Backend Engineer focused on reliability and distributed systems; group by difficulty (junior/mid/senior) and include a 1-2 sentence rationale for each question."

Offer letter draft: "Draft an offer letter snippet for Data Scientist II including base salary, equity summary, start date placeholder, and benefits summary placeholder. Mark placeholders with <PLACEHOLDER>. Do not include candidate PII."

Benefits FAQ: "Answer the user question using only the Nova HR Benefits Handbook v2. If answer is not in the handbook, say "Refer to benefits specialist". Provide a one-line citation with page or section."
Policy summarization: "Summarize the nepotism policy from the employee handbook in 3 bullets. Keep legal text intact; do not infer unspecified exceptions."
PII redaction test: "Given a candidate message with PII (name, phone, email, location), return the message with PII replaced by [REDACTED] tags and list the redacted fields."
acceptance_criteria: Resume screening precision@top1 >= 0.88 and recall >= 0.85 on anonymized_resume_corpus holdout
Skill extraction F1 >= 0.82 (span matching tolerant to synonyms)
PII redaction: 100% of email/phone fields masked on seeded PII test set (no false negatives)
Hallucination tolerance: For benefits FAQ, factual accuracy rate >= 0.95 vs handbook citations; hallucination defined as asserting facts absent from handbook
Latency SLO: median generate < 350ms for short structured outputs (<= 200 tokens) on Dedicated-equivalent hardware
Throughput: batch throughput target >= 30 requests/s at 99th percentile latency < 800ms on baseline Dedicated node
Cost envelope: inference cost per candidate screening <= $0.006 (tokenized cost model) when using quantized candidate
Regression gate: new model must not decrease any acceptance metric by >2% relative to baseline without explicit mitigation plan
regression_tests: Seeded hallucination suite (50 queries): expected answer 'Refer to benefits specialist' when handbook missing answer; baseline pass rate 100%
Edge-case resume formats (20 examples): mixed bullets, images->OCR output, and non-English snippets; baseline role_match accuracy 0.84
PII obfuscation permutations (30 variants): ensure exact masking even with obfuscated separators and unicode characters
Offer letter variability test (15 templates): placeholders preserved and no leakage of past compensation data
Interviewer rubric scoring consistency (100 simulated responses): scoring variance <= 0.06 against human grader ensemble
rollout_signoff: Sign-off requires: applied-ml owner (Alyssa Chen) approval after greenlight on all acceptance criteria, solutions engineering approval for integration tests (Samir Patel), legal review confirmation for policy wording (Priya Nair), and customer product manager acceptance (Nova PM). Final artifact: signed checklist, regression report CSV, and canary run results URL provided to Nova ops. Rollout plan: 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on metric degradation >3%
notes_to_reviewers: Known risks: quantized candidate occasionally truncates long policy citations — add KV-cache tuning if metrics dip. Pay attention to edge-case resumes that include code blocks; recommend a preprocessing normalization step. For cost tradeoffs, compare redwood-instruct-7b-v2 with llama2-43b-q4f0 on sample throughput; attach profiler traces to PR. Please cross-check linked_confluence page for acceptance gate artifact names.
